thread:
oleksandr: Hi — noticed invoice INV-2026-03-01 for account acct_9AZ shows total EUR 1023.57 but dashboard shows EUR 1023.49. Small delta (0.08) but customer is asking. link: https://app.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-03-01

zoe_support: Thanks for flagging. Can you paste the invoice PDF number and a sample request id or two? Also which workspace/org?

oleksandr: Sure org: datadrift-prod, invoice attached. Sample request ids: req_01G7XQY3Y2J, req_01G7XQY3Y7Z. The dashboard usage shows token_total=12345.0, invoice token line shows 12352 tokens. Also VAT on some lines looks rounded per line. PDF: https://files.redwood.com/invoices/INV-2026-03-01.pdf

zoe_support: pinging @mike_billing and @anjali_engineer to help triage. billing-bot recorded invoice generation job id job_98321

mike_billing: Taking this. At first glance two likely causes: 1) billing tokenizer vs runtime tokenizer mismatch (we bill using billing-tokenizer v2 which can count sub-tokens differently for concatenated ops) 2) VAT rounding per line vs VAT on total. Either could create ~0.05-0.10 deltas. Will reproduce.

anjali_engineer: Can you share the raw payload or a scrubbed curl snippet? If it's a mix of embeddings + generation we might be double-counting prompt tokens in the billing pipeline for concatenated batch requests.

oleksandr: here's a redacted sample:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -d '{
    "model":"rwd-instruct-large",
    "input":"Summarize the following logs:\n...",
    "max_tokens":256
  }'
```

and one embeddings request that ran in same minute:

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-small","input":"dataset id: 42..."}'
```

mike_billing: OK reproducing locally with those request ids. Quick check: dashboard uses runtime-tokenizer v1 (used by inference runtime) while billing pipeline runs billing-tokenizer v2 which normalizes whitespace and counts contractions differently. For these payloads billing-tokenizer gave +7 tokens total vs runtime. That explains token delta 12345 -> 12352.

anjali_engineer: That's a product mismatch. We should either align billing tokenizer to runtime or normalize token counting at ingestion. But we also need to check the VAT rounding: current invoice applies VAT per-line (line_amount * VAT_rate then rounded to cents) which can add a few cents when many small lines exist.

mike_billing: For this invoice, both effects present. Tokens delta -> +7 tokens => +0.35 EUR, VAT line rounding nets -0.27 EUR, final +0.08 EUR. I'll propose a credit of EUR 0.08 for this invoice and a follow-up patch to change VAT calc to apply on invoice total for EU customers with small-line buckets.

zoe_support: Thanks. Proposed customer-facing reply: apologize, explain tokenizer mismatch and line-level VAT rounding, offer one-off credit EUR 0.08 and timeline for fix. @oleksandr ok to issue credit?

oleksandr: Yes please issue credit. Also can you log this so we don't hit it every month? We do a lot of small embedding requests.

mike_billing: Logged as BILL-1298 (billing tokenizer + per-line VAT rounding). We'll issue credit now; I'll update when done.

billing-bot: Credit issued: credit_5561 for acct_9AZ amount EUR 0.08. Invoice balance updated.

zoe_support: Closing loop: credit issued, tracking ticket BILL-1298 for longer term fix (target: apply VAT on invoice totals for EU small-line customers + align tokenizers). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

oleksandr: Thanks much. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
